summary: Risk-off open for tech: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO (CFO Kress interim), NVDA ~-12% premarket, Nasdaq 100 futures ~-1.4%, S&P ~-0.8%; AMD and Broadcom bid as share-gain beneficiaries, neoclouds sliding (Nebius guide, CoreWeave giveback). Live quotes blocked; prices are premarket estimates from news snapshots. Calendar: jobless claims, existing home sales 10:00 ET, Cisco/AMAT after the close.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: William Blair upgrade to Outperform plus share-gain bets on Nvidia's leadership vacuum, up ~3% premarket from 552.90; over 575 extends toward 584, under 560 the gap fades with the semis.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: CEO Huang resigned amid scandal, Oppenheimer downgrade, ~-12% premarket from 173.73 to 16-month lows; under 150 the flush continues, over 158 a gap-fill bounce is underway.

picks.name: Eli Lilly
picks.reason: Up ~3% premarket on China approval of its oral GLP-1, a defensive haven as tech sells off; over 1500 runs, under 1470 the gap fades (premarket estimate).

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq 100 futures ~-1.4% on the Nvidia shock after Wednesday's close at 690.38; under 677 the selloff extends, over 686 dip buyers have it (price estimated from futures).

picks.name: CoreWeave
picks.reason: Down ~10-14% premarket giving back Wednesday's earnings pop as Nebius' weak guide and Nvidia turmoil hit neoclouds; under 51.5 extends, over 56.5 the put is wrong (price estimated).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P futures ~-0.8% with the 10-year near 5% and oil up; under 750 the drop broadens, over 757.5 the market shrugs off Nvidia (price estimated from futures).
